title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING TWENTY THOUSAND DOLLARS IN PAYMENT OF SMALL EXPENSES INCURRED BY THE WAR DEPARTMENT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE PHILIPPINE

text.en:
The sum of twenty thousand dollars in money of the United States is hereby appropriated for the
payment of sundry small expenses incurred int he United States for the benefit of the Military Government
of the Philippine Islands by order of the Secretary of War.1aшphi1

The Insular Treasurer is hereby authorized and directed to remit by cable to the disbursing clerk of
the War Department at Washington, the sum herein appropriated, upon the warrant of the Military Governor
for the same.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 26, 1900.
